verdict.rationale: Model and provider portability is a fair question for an agent orchestration framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents swapping the LLM provider or model without rewriting the agent. The closest material is community comments that nodes are arbitrary functions and that LangChain abstractions are optional add-ons, which are developer building blocks rather than a documented provider-swap capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent
